description: This is a C header file defining utility functions, includes, and external references for ucode (microcode) operations within the hostapd-related code. It declares interfaces for creating, running, and managing a ucode virtual machine, as well as functions for registry management and various utility functions specific to WPA (Wireless Protected Access).

methods.name: wpa_ucode_create_vm
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ucode virtual machine instance.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_run
methods.description: Executes a given ucode script within the virtual machine.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_call_prepare
methods.description: Prepares a function call within the ucode environment, identified by filename.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_call
methods.description: Calls a ucode function with a specified number of arguments.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_free_vm
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the ucode virtual machine.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_global_init
methods.description: Initializes a global variable or resource within the ucode environment.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_add
methods.description: Adds a value to the ucode registry.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the ucode registry by index.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_remove
methods.description: Removes a value from the ucode registry by index.

methods.name: uc_wpa_udebug_set
methods.description: Sets debug parameters for ucode within a VM.

methods.name: uc_wpa_printf
methods.description: Prints formatted ucode debug or informational messages.

methods.name: uc_wpa_getpid
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID within ucode environment.
